Every figure treats the catalogue of 41 tools below as a data set (year, language, input, output resolution), and every number can be recomputed from `catalog.csv` with the R code at the end. ## 1. 为什么重复序列要单独一套方法 / Why repeats need their own methods

人类基因组里约一半是重复序列，玉米与小麦都在 85% 左右[4,5,6]。这些序列不是垃圾：它们携带启动子、增强子与沉默子，在胚胎发育、免疫与肿瘤里被重新启用[10]；L1 的插入可以打断基因并造成疾病[9]；反转录转座子的爆发直接决定基因组大小。T2T 组装完成后大家才看清，过去二十年所有参考基因组里缺失的，主要就是这些区域[7,8]。

About half of the human genome is repetitive, and both maize and wheat sit near 85% [4,5,6]. These sequences are not junk: they carry promoters, enhancers and silencers that are reactivated during development, immunity and cancer [10]; an L1 insertion can interrupt a gene and cause disease [9]; and bursts of retrotransposition set genome size directly. Only after the T2T assembly did it become clear that what the previous two decades of reference genomes were missing is exactly these regions [7,8].

技术上的难处可以用一句话说清：**重复序列破坏了「一条读段只属于一个位置」这个假设**。一段 100 bp 的读段如果完全落在 Alu 共识序列内部，它在基因组里可能有几十万个几乎等价的落点；比对器只能给出一个 MAPQ 0 的随机答案，或者干脆丢掉。于是所有下游问题——变异检测、表达定量、组装——都必须换成「先识别重复，再决定怎么分配」的思路。这正是这一整类工具存在的理由，两篇综述把它梳理得比本文系统得多[2,3]。

The technical difficulty fits in one sentence: **repeats break the assumption that a read belongs to exactly one place**. A 100 bp read lying entirely inside an Alu consensus may have hundreds of thousands of near-equivalent placements; the aligner either reports a MAPQ 0 guess or throws it away. Every downstream question — variant calling, expression, assembly — therefore has to be rephrased as "identify the repeat first, then decide how to allocate". That is the reason this whole class of tools exists, and two reviews cover it far more systematically than this post can [2,3].

## 2. 先分类，再谈工具 / Classify first, then choose a tool

所有工具都建立在同一套分类上：Wicker 等人 2007 年提出的统一分类系统[1]。它按**转座机制**分两大类，再按**结构特征**分目与超科。分类不是学术洁癖——每一种类型都有自己可被算法捕捉的「签名」，工具之间真正的差别，是它们各自认哪几种签名。

Every tool rests on the same taxonomy: the unified classification of Wicker et al. 2007 [1]. It splits by **mechanism** into two classes, then by **structural signature** into orders and superfamilies. The taxonomy is not pedantry — each class has a signature an algorithm can detect, and the real difference between tools is which signatures they recognise.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    TE["转座元件 / transposable elements"] --> C1["Class I 逆转录转座子<br/>copy and paste"]
    TE --> C2["Class II DNA 转座子<br/>cut and paste"]
    C1 --> LTR["LTR 型<br/>Ty1/copia · Ty3/gypsy · ERV"]
    C1 --> NL["非 LTR 型<br/>LINE（ORF1/ORF2）· SINE（Alu）"]
    C2 --> TIR["TIR 型<br/>hAT · CACTA · Tc1/mariner · PIF/Harbinger"]
    C2 --> HEL["Helitron<br/>rolling circle"]
    TIR --> MITE["MITE<br/>非自主，靠 TIR + TSD"]
    TE --> SAT["串联重复<br/>卫星 · rDNA · 端粒"]
```

每种签名对应一组可检测的特征：LTR 型有**两端长末端重复 + 引物结合位点（PBS）+ 多嘌呤 tract（PPT）+ 目标位点重复（TSD）**；TIR 型有**末端反向重复 + TSD**；Helitron 有**5′ 端的 TC 与 3′ 端的 CTAG 发夹**；SINE 有**tRNA 来源的头部（A box / B box）+ 3′ 尾**；LINE 有**ORF1/ORF2 结构域 + poly-A**。结构驱动的工具就是在序列里找这些特征的组合，同源驱动的工具则是把序列拿去和已知家族比对。

Each signature maps to a set of detectable features: LTR elements carry **two long terminal repeats plus a primer binding site (PBS), a polypurine tract (PPT) and a target site duplication (TSD)**; TIR elements carry **terminal inverted repeats plus a TSD**; Helitrons carry **a 5′ TC and a 3′ CTAG hairpin**; SINEs carry **a tRNA-derived head (A box / B box) and a 3′ tail**; LINEs carry **ORF1/ORF2 domains and a poly-A tail**. Structure-based tools look for combinations of these features; homology-based tools search a known family library instead.

## 3. 三条技术路线 / Three technical routes

```{r}
#| label: tbl-routes
#| echo: false
t1 <- data.frame(
  路线 = c("同源比对 / homology", "从头发现 / de novo", "结构特征 / structure"),
  假设 = c("已知家族库足够全", "重复会在序列里留下过量片段", "类型有可检测的结构签名"),
  输入 = c("组装 + 库", "组装或读段", "组装"),
  强项 = c("边界准、可给 divergence", "能发现库里没有的家族", "不需要库、灵敏度高"),
  弱项 = c("库外的一律漏掉", "共识易嵌合、易过度拆分", "假阳性多、需二次过滤"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
kable(t1, row.names = FALSE, align = "l",
      caption = "三条路线各自的赌注 | what each route bets on")
```

三条路线不是互斥的，现代流水线基本都是混合体：EDTA 用结构工具找 LTR/TIR/Helitron、用 RepeatModeler 兜底，再统一过滤[22]；Earl Grey 与 McClintock 同样把三类证据拼起来[44,45]。理解路线的意义在于：当你看到一个「TE 占比」的数字，先问它是哪条路线、哪个库算出来的——三者能差出十个百分点。

The three routes are not exclusive; modern pipelines are hybrids. EDTA calls LTR, TIR and Helitron structurally, falls back on RepeatModeler for the rest, then filters globally [22]; Earl Grey and McClintock splice the same three kinds of evidence [44,45]. The point of knowing the routes is that when you see a "TE fraction", you should ask which route and which library produced it — they can differ by ten percentage points.

## 4. 同源注释：RepeatMasker 与它的库 / Homology: RepeatMasker and its libraries

RepeatMasker 是这个领域的地基，1996 年至今仍在维护（<https://www.repeatmasker.org>）。它的实现是「搜索 + 分类」两步：先把序列与一个重复库做局部比对，再把每个命中归到库里最相似的那条记录上。搜索引擎可以换：最早的 `cross_match` 是 Smith-Waterman，后来加入 `RMBlast`（针对重复序列调过参数的 NCBI BLAST），再后来加入 `nhmmer`，可以直接搜 Dfam 的 HMM 模型[12]。输出 `.out`（逐条比对）、`.gff`、`.masked`（软屏蔽或硬屏蔽序列）、`.tbl`（按家族汇总）。

RepeatMasker is the foundation of the field and has been maintained since 1996 (<https://www.repeatmasker.org>). Its implementation is "search, then classify": align the sequence locally against a repeat library, then assign each hit to the most similar record. The search engine is swappable: the original `cross_match` is Smith-Waterman, `RMBlast` is an NCBI BLAST tuned for repeats, and `nhmmer` searches the HMM profiles of Dfam directly [12]. It writes `.out` (per-hit alignments), `.gff`, `.masked` (soft- or hard-masked sequence) and `.tbl` (per-family summary).

两个库决定了它的上限。**Dfam** 用 profile HMM 描述家族，适合远缘与短片段；**Repbase** 是历史最久的收集，但近年已不再免费公开发布新版本，这直接导致老流程不可复现。所以任何认真的项目都会先建一个**物种特异库**，而那需要第 5 节的方法。

Two libraries set its ceiling. **Dfam** describes families as profile HMMs, which suits diverged and short fragments; **Repbase** is the oldest collection but no longer distributes new releases freely, which is exactly why old pipelines are hard to reproduce. Any serious project therefore builds a **species-specific library** first — and that needs the methods of section 5.

RepeatMasker 还附带一个被低估的功能：**divergence landscape**。`calcDivergenceFromAlign.pl` 把每条比对换算成 Kimura 二参数距离（并做 CpG 校正），`createRepeatLandscape.pl` 再把「各家族在不同 divergence 区间的基因组占比」画成曲线。横轴是从现在往回的时间，纵轴是量——曲线的峰就是一次爆发。这张图是整个 TE 领域最有信息量的单张图，因为它同时告诉你「有什么」和「什么时候进来的」。

RepeatMasker ships an underrated feature: the **divergence landscape**. `calcDivergenceFromAlign.pl` converts each alignment into a Kimura two-parameter distance (with CpG correction), and `createRepeatLandscape.pl` plots the genome fraction of each family against divergence. The x axis is time going backwards, the y axis is amount — a peak is a burst. It is the single most informative plot in the field, because it answers "what is there" and "when did it arrive" at once.

## 5. 从头发现：没有库怎么办 / De novo discovery

当物种没有像样的库时，只能从序列自身把重复「找出来」。四种经典算法的差别在于用什么统计量定义「过量」：

When a species has no decent library, repeats have to be recovered from the sequence itself. The four classic algorithms differ in what statistic defines "over-represented":

- **RepeatScout**：数 $l$-mer（默认 $l = 15$），保留出现次数显著高于随机期望的，从这些种子向两侧贪心延伸，直到频率掉下来，最后多序列比对出共识。快、简单，但对低拷贝家族不敏感[14]。\
    *Counts $l$-mers (default 15), keeps those far above the random expectation, extends each seed greedily to both sides while it stays frequent, then builds a consensus by multiple alignment. Fast and simple, but blind to low-copy families.*
- **RECON**：先做全基因组自比对，再用单链接聚类把命中连成家族，然后检测每个家族的 3′ 端、做多序列比对。它的家族定义更接近生物学[15]。\
    *Self-aligns the genome, links hits into families by single-linkage clustering, then finds 3′ ends and builds alignments. Its families look more biological.*
- **Piler**：为基因组建后缀数组，找极大精确重复，过滤掉低复杂度和嵌套的，再聚类成家族。理论最干净，内存最贵[16]。\
    *Builds a suffix array of the genome, finds maximal exact repeats, filters low-complexity and nested ones, then clusters into families. Theoretically cleanest, most memory-hungry [16].*
- **RepeatExplorer2**：完全不用参考基因组——把低覆盖度读段做成 k-mer 相似性图，图里的连通分量就是重复家族，再按蛋白结构域注释。对超大基因组特别有用[51]。\
    *Needs no reference at all: builds a k-mer similarity graph over low-coverage reads, takes connected components as repeat families, then annotates by protein domain. Especially useful for huge genomes.*

**RepeatModeler2** 本身不是新算法，而是编排：对基因组抽样，分别跑 RECON、RepeatScout 与 LTR 结构发现，把结果合并去冗余，最后用 `RepeatClassifier` 按 Dfam/RepeatPeps 的 HMM 给每个共识打上 class/family 标签[13]。它 2020 年的改进主要在合并策略与 LTR 处理，产出的 `consensi.fa.classified` 就是喂给 RepeatMasker 的库。**EDTA** 把同样的思路推到极限：TIR-Learner 找 TIR、HelitronScanner 找 Helitron、LTRharvest + LTR_retriever 找 LTR、RepeatModeler 兜底，然后做一次全基因组结构验证来剔除假阳性，最后输出非冗余库 + GFF[22]。

**RepeatModeler2** is not a new algorithm but an orchestration: sample the genome, run RECON, RepeatScout and structural LTR discovery, merge and de-duplicate, then label every consensus with `RepeatClassifier` against Dfam/RepeatPeps HMMs [13]. Its 2020 gains are mostly in merging and LTR handling; the output `consensi.fa.classified` is exactly the library RepeatMasker wants. **EDTA** pushes the same idea to its limit: TIR-Learner for TIRs, HelitronScanner for Helitrons, LTRharvest + LTR_retriever for LTRs, RepeatModeler for the remainder, then a whole-genome structural validation pass to remove false positives, and finally a non-redundant library plus GFF [22].

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    G["基因组 / assembly"] --> T["TIR-Learner"]
    G --> H["HelitronScanner"]
    G --> L["LTRharvest + LTR_retriever"]
    G --> R["RepeatModeler2"]
    T --> M["合并 + 全基因组验证<br/>merge and validate"]
    H --> M
    L --> M
    R --> M
    M --> LIB["非冗余库 / EDTA.TElib.fa"]
    LIB --> RM["RepeatMasker"]
    RM --> OUT["GFF3 + 家族统计 + landscape"]
```

这类流水线共同的软肋是**共识质量**：从头拼出来的共识可能把两个相邻的不同元件粘成一条（嵌合），也可能把一个家族拆成十几条（碎片化）。前者让 RepeatMasker 报出根本不存在的家族，后者让「家族数」这个统计量失去意义。所以 EDTA、Earl Grey 都保留了人工审阅与 curated library 的接口。

The shared weakness of these pipelines is **consensus quality**: a de novo consensus can glue two adjacent elements into one (chimera), or split one family into a dozen (fragmentation). The first makes RepeatMasker report families that never existed; the second makes "number of families" meaningless. Both EDTA and Earl Grey therefore keep an interface for manual review and a curated library.

## 6. 结构驱动：把签名写成算法 / Structure-driven: signatures as algorithms

结构工具不依赖库，只依赖签名，因此灵敏度高、假阳性也高。

Structural tools depend on signatures rather than libraries, which buys sensitivity at the cost of false positives.

- **LTRharvest**（GenomeTools 的一部分，C 实现）：在序列里找一对**完全相同的 30-mer**，要求方向相同、距离在 1–15 kb 之间；以此为种子向两侧延伸成候选 LTR；再检查 TSD（4–6 bp 正向重复）、PPT 与 PBS。整个过程走后缀索引，速度极快[17]。\
    *Finds a pair of identical 30-mers in the same orientation 1–15 kb apart, extends them into candidate LTRs, then checks for a TSD (4–6 bp), a PPT and a PBS. It runs on a suffix index and is very fast [17].*
- **LTR_FINDER**：思路类似但用比对而非精确种子，低相似度的 LTR 也能抓到，代价是慢[18]。\
    *Similar idea but seeded by alignment rather than exact matches, so it catches diverged LTRs at the cost of speed [18].*
- **LTR_retriever**：不发现，只做质检。它把 LTRharvest / LTR_FINDER 的候选拿来做严格过滤（两端 LTR 一致性、TSD、PPT、PBS、蛋白结构域），去冗余后重定边界，并顺带算出 **LAI**（LTR Assembly Index）——一个用 LTR 完整度衡量组装连续性的指标[21]。\
    *It does not discover, it audits: takes LTRharvest/LTR_FINDER candidates, filters hard (LTR identity, TSD, PPT, PBS, protein domains), de-redundifies, redefines boundaries, and computes **LAI**, an assembly-continuity metric derived from LTR completeness [21].*
- **TIR-Learner**：找末端反向重复对 + TSD，再用机器学习分类器把真正的 TIR 转座子与其它重复分开[23]。\
    *Finds inverted-repeat pairs plus TSDs, then uses a machine-learning classifier to separate true TIR transposons from other repeats [23].*
- **HelitronScanner**：把 5′ 端与 3′ 端分别用两个 SVM 识别（输入是「局部组合变量」编码），再把两端配对成元件[24]。\
    *Recognises 5′ and 3′ ends with two separate SVMs over a "local combinational variable" encoding, then pairs the ends into elements [24].*
- **SINE_Scan**：利用 SINE 的 tRNA 来源头部（A box / B box）与 3′ 端相似性成对搜索[25]。\
    *Exploits the tRNA-derived head (A box / B box) and 3′ similarity of SINEs, searching the two ends as a pair [25].*

结构工具的通病是**过调用**：LTRharvest 默认会报出大量「有 LTR 但没有内部结构」的候选，TIR-Learner 的原始输出也远多于真实元件。所以这一层的正确用法几乎总是「先放宽阈值拿候选，再用 LTR_retriever 或人工规则收紧」。这条经验在 EDTA 的设计里被写死：结构工具只负责提议，过滤器负责裁决。

The shared flaw of structural tools is **over-calling**: LTRharvest reports many candidates with LTRs but no internal structure, and raw TIR-Learner output far exceeds real elements. The correct use of this layer is therefore almost always "loosen the threshold to collect candidates, then tighten with LTR_retriever or manual rules". EDTA hard-codes this lesson: structural tools propose, filters decide.

## 7. 分类器：这一步最不可靠 / Classifiers: the weakest link

拿到共识序列之后，还要回答「它属于哪一类」。三条实现路线：

Once a consensus exists, the next question is "what class is it". Three implementations:

- **PASTEC**：把结构特征（LTR、TIR、TSD、PBS、poly-A、ORF 结构域）喂进一棵人工写的决策树，输出 Wicker 分类[26]。可解释性最好，覆盖不了树外的情况。\
    *Feeds structural features (LTR, TIR, TSD, PBS, poly-A, ORF domains) into a hand-written decision tree that emits a Wicker class [26]. Maximally interpretable, and blind to anything outside the tree.*
- **TEclass**：在 $k$-mer 频率上训练 SVM，分到 DNA / LTR / LINE / SINE 四类[27]。训练集小，只能到「目」这一层。\
    *Trains an SVM on $k$-mer frequencies into DNA/LTR/LINE/SINE [27]. Small training set; only reaches order level.*
- **TERL / DeepTE / TransposonUltimate**：把 $k$-mer 谱当成一维信号或图片，用卷积网络分类[28,29,30]。DeepTE 支持在自有标签上微调；TransposonUltimate 把 TERL 的 CNN 与一个基于结构特征的随机森林（RFSB）集成起来，再套一层 RepeatMasker 做检测。\
    *Treat the $k$-mer spectrum as a 1-D signal or an image and classify with a CNN [28,29,30]. DeepTE can be fine-tuned on your own labels; TransposonUltimate ensembles TERL's CNN with a random forest over structural features (RFSB) and wraps a RepeatMasker detection layer around it.*

分类之所以最不可靠，有三个结构性的原因：训练标签本身来自 Repbase，带着它的偏差；类别极不平衡（LTR 与 DNA 转座子样本远多于其它）；以及大量真实元件是**非自主**的，只剩两端签名，任何基于内部结构的分类都会失效。实践中的处理是：分类只当参考，家族名手工审；对非自主元件（MITE、SINE）单独用结构工具。

Classification is the weakest link for three structural reasons: the training labels come from Repbase and inherit its biases; classes are severely imbalanced (LTR and DNA transposons dominate); and many real elements are **non-autonomous**, retaining only their terminal signatures, which defeats any classifier built on internal structure. In practice: treat the class as a hint, curate family names by hand, and use structural tools separately for non-autonomous elements (MITEs, SINEs).

## 8. 从基因组到转录组：表达定量 / From genome to transcriptome

第二大类问题不是「在哪里」，而是「表达多少」。这一层全部围绕同一个数学困难：**一条落在重复内部的读段，可能来自几千个位点**，如何分配决定了你能得到什么。

The second big question is not "where" but "how much". This layer is entirely about one mathematical difficulty: **a read inside a repeat may come from thousands of loci**, and how you allocate it decides what you can estimate.

- **TEtranscripts / TEcount**（Python）：读 BAM，分别对基因注释与 TE 注释计数；多映射读段先给基因，剩下的给 TE；`--mode multi` 用 EM 迭代分配[31]。输出可直接进 DESeq2。\
    *Read a BAM, count against gene and TE annotation separately; multi-mapping reads go to genes first, then to TEs; `--mode multi` allocates them by EM [31]. The output feeds straight into DESeq2.*
- **TEtools**（R）：把读段比对到 TE 库、按家族汇总，剩下的差异分析在 R 里做[32]。\
    *Maps reads to a TE library, sums by family, and does the differential analysis in R [32].*
- **SalmonTE**（Python）：把每个亚家族当成一条转录本，用 salmon 的准比对做定量，因此极快；代价是只到亚家族级[33]。\
    *Treats each subfamily as a transcript and quantifies with salmon's quasi-mapping, hence very fast; the price is subfamily-only resolution [33].*
- **SQuIRE**（Python）：在 TE 共识两侧加「唯一锚点」建索引，多映射读段用 EM 分配到具体位点，输出亚家族与位点两套计数[34]。\
    *Indexes each TE consensus with unique genomic anchors on both sides, allocates multi-mapping reads to loci by EM, and reports both subfamily and locus counts [34].*
- **Telescope**（Python）：用一个生成模型对多映射读段做概率重分配，专门做 L1 的位点级定量[35]。\
    *Probabilistically reassigns multi-mapping reads under a generative model, aimed at locus-level L1 quantification [35].*
- **REdiscoverTE**（R/Bioconductor）：把约 150 万个重复位点折叠到亚家族层，用 EM 定量，接口是 `SummarizedExperiment`[36]。\
    *Collapses roughly 1.5 million repeat loci to subfamily level, quantifies by EM, and returns a `SummarizedExperiment` [36].*
- **scTE**（Python）：把同一套分配问题搬到单细胞，输出 cell × TE 矩阵，用于看 TE 表达的细胞类型特异性[37]。\
    *Moves the same allocation problem into single cells, producing a cell × TE matrix for cell-type-specific TE expression [37].*
- **L1EM**（Python）：只做 L1，用位点特异的唯一 $k$-mer 加 EM，给出位点级估计[52]。\
    *L1 only: locus-specific unique $k$-mers plus EM, giving locus-level estimates [52].*

这里有一个必须说清的**可辨识性边界**：家族级（亚家族级）的表达量在数学上是可辨识的，因为同一家族的所有拷贝共享序列，读段总量就是它们的和；位点级则**不可辨识**，除非每个位点都有独特的锚点或杂合标记。SQuIRE 与 Telescope 给出的位点级数字，本质上是模型假设下的后验分配，不是观测。把它们当「某拷贝的表达量」用，是这一层最常见的误用。

There is an **identifiability boundary** worth stating plainly: family-level (subfamily-level) expression is identifiable, because all copies of a family share sequence and the reads simply sum; locus-level expression is **not identifiable** unless each locus carries a unique anchor or heterozygous marker. The locus-level numbers from SQuIRE and Telescope are posterior allocations under model assumptions, not observations. Treating them as "the expression of that copy" is the most common misuse in this layer.

## 9. 插入多态：个体之间差在哪 / Insertion polymorphism

第三个问题：这个 TE 在某个体里到底插没插进去。短读段只能靠**间接信号**：一头锚在唯一序列、另一头落在 TE 里的不一致读段对（discordant pair），或者跨越断点的分裂读段（split read）。

The third question: is this TE inserted in this individual or not. Short reads can only use **indirect signals**: discordant pairs with one end anchored in unique sequence and the other in a TE, or split reads spanning the breakpoint.

- **RetroSeq**（Perl）：收集不一致读段对，按 TE 类型聚类，再局部重比对确认断点[39]。\
    *Collects discordant pairs, clusters them by TE type, and confirms breakpoints by local realignment [39].*
- **MELT**（Java）：把不一致读段、分裂读段与局部组装三路证据合起来，Alu/LINE/SVA 分别建模，还能给每个插入做基因型[38]。\
    *Combines discordant pairs, split reads and local assembly, models Alu/LINE/SVA separately, and genotypes each insertion [38].*
- **Mobster**（Java）：换一个信号——直接找**目标位点重复（TSD）**，因此对参考基因组的依赖更小[40]。\
    *Uses a different signal: it looks for the **target site duplication (TSD)** directly, and therefore depends less on the reference [40].*
- **PoPoolationTE2**（Python）：面向混池测序，用物理覆盖度的「签名」估计每个插入的群体频率[41]。\
    *For pooled sequencing, estimating each insertion's population frequency from physical-coverage signatures [41].*
- **TEMP**（Python）：同样面向混池，用配对读段的插入片段长度分布做最大似然估计[42]。\
    *Also for pools, using a maximum-likelihood fit to the insert-size distribution of paired reads [42].*
- **TLDR**（C++）：长读段方案。一条读段可以直接跨过整个插入，于是「分配」问题消失，只剩比对与断点解析[43]。\
    *The long-read answer: one read can span the whole insertion, so the allocation problem disappears and only alignment and breakpoint parsing remain [43].*

**长读段为什么改变游戏**：短读段的插入检测本质上是统计推断（我看到了间接证据，推断这里有一个插入），长读段则是直接观测（我看到了这个插入）。代价是覆盖度与成本，以及长读段自身在高重复区的错误率。

**Why long reads change the game**: short-read insertion detection is statistical inference (I saw indirect evidence, so I infer an insertion), whereas long reads are direct observation (I saw the insertion). The price is coverage and cost, plus the error rate of long reads in high-repeat regions.

## 10. 卫星与串联重复：另一类问题 / Satellites and tandem repeats

卫星 DNA 与 TE 的数学结构不同：它不是「同一段序列散落在多处」，而是「同一段序列首尾相接重复很多次」。所以比对类工具在这里基本失效，需要的是**周期性检测**与**同一性轨迹**。

Satellite DNA differs mathematically from TEs: it is not "the same sequence scattered in many places" but "the same unit repeated head-to-tail many times". Alignment tools fail here; what is needed is **periodicity detection** and **identity tracks**.

- **TRF**（C）：在 Bernoulli 模型下给匹配/错配打分，先检测周期性种子，再用动态规划把每个 period 的比对延伸到最优[48]。它是所有串联重复注释的默认起点。\
    *Scores matches and mismatches under a Bernoulli model, detects periodic seeds, then extends each period's alignment by dynamic programming [48]. It is the default starting point for tandem repeat annotation.*
- **StainedGlass**（C++ + R）：对每个重复单元计算它相对家族模型的逐碱基同一性，输出可交互的「同一性热图」，从而看清高阶重复（HOR）结构与突变梯度[46]。\
    *Computes per-base identity of every repeat unit against a family model and emits an interactive identity heatmap, exposing higher-order repeat (HOR) structure and mutation gradients [46].*
- **HumAS-HMMER**（Python + HMMER）：用 HOR 拷贝的 HMM 库注释 alpha satellite 阵列，是 T2T 中心粒图谱的核心工具之一[47]。\
    *Annotates alpha satellite arrays with an HMM library of HOR copies; one of the core tools behind the T2T centromere maps [47].*
- **ExpansionHunter**（C++）：把短串联重复（STR）建成图，再用读段在图上游走，输出各等位基因的长度[49]。\
    *Builds a graph of the short tandem repeat and walks reads through it to genotype allele lengths [49].*

## 11. 谁用什么语言写 / Who writes these tools in what

把目录按语言统计一遍，会看到一条非常清晰的时代曲线。

Count the catalogue by language and a clean era curve appears.

```{r}
#| label: fig-lang
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "按年代统计的实现语言：算法年代归 C/C++，应用年代归 Python | implementation language by era: C/C++ for the algorithm years, Python for the application years"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.2
ggplot(tl, aes(era, fill = lang2)) +
  geom_bar(width = .68) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`C/C++` = blog_pal[["green"]], Perl = blog_pal[["blue"]],
                               Python = blog_pal[["vermillion"]],
                               Java = blog_pal[["purple"]], R = blog_pal[["orange"]]),
                    name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "年代 / era", y = "工具数 / number of tools")
```

1996–2004 只有三件：Perl 的 RepeatMasker，加上两个 C 写的算法（RECON 与 TRF）。2005–2009 的六件全部是 C/C++ —— 那是算法年代，后缀数组、精确种子搜索、图聚类都得自己管内存。2010–2014 开始混杂。2015 年之后 Python 拿走几乎全部新工具（`r n_lang("Python")` 个），C/C++ 仍有 `r n_lang("C/C++")` 个守在内核（GenomeTools、TRF、RepeatMasker 的搜索器、TLDR、StainedGlass），而 Perl 退成了「胶水」：EDTA 与 RepeatModeler2 用它把 C 程序、HMMER 与 shell 脚本粘在一起（`r n_lang("Perl")` 个）。

There were only three tools in 1996–2004: Perl's RepeatMasker plus two C algorithms (RECON and TRF). All six tools of 2005–2009 are C/C++ — that was the algorithm era, when suffix arrays, exact-seed search and graph clustering meant managing memory yourself. 2010–2014 is mixed. After 2015 Python took nearly every new tool (`r n_lang("Python")`), C/C++ kept `r n_lang("C/C++")` in the kernel (GenomeTools, TRF, RepeatMasker's engines, TLDR, StainedGlass), and Perl retreated into glue: EDTA and RepeatModeler2 use it to stick C programs, HMMER and shell scripts together (`r n_lang("Perl")`).

这条曲线对使用者有一个直接后果：**装一套完整的 TE 流程，等于同时维护四个生态**——Perl 模块（`Text::Soundex`、`File::Which` 之类）、Python 环境（TensorFlow 版本的兼容性尤其麻烦）、Java 运行时，以及需要自己编译的 C/C++ 二进制。这不是审美问题，而是「三年后还能不能跑起来」的问题。

One practical consequence: **assembling a complete TE pipeline means maintaining four ecosystems at once** — Perl modules (`Text::Soundex`, `File::Which` and friends), Python environments (TensorFlow version compatibility being the worst), a Java runtime, and C/C++ binaries you compile yourself. That is not aesthetics; it is whether the thing still runs three years from now.

```{r}
#| label: fig-timeline
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "41 个工具的发布时间与所属子领域 | publication year and subfield of the 41 tools"
#| fig-width: 8.6
#| fig-height: 4.4
ggplot(tl, aes(year, category, colour = category)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.17, size = 2.2, alpha = .95) +
  geom_text(data = tl[tool %in% c("RepeatMasker", "LTRharvest", "EDTA", "McClintock")],
            aes(label = tool), nudge_y = 0.33, size = 2.6, colour = "grey30",
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cat_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = cat_lab) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1996, 2024, 4)) +
  labs(x = "发布年份 / year", y = NULL)
```

看时间轴能读出三条史：**注释层**（蓝）从 1996 一直续到今天，每次高潮都对应一次库或流水线的更新；**结构层**（绿）集中在 2007–2019，正好是「LTRharvest → LTR_retriever → TIR-Learner」这条改进链；**表达层**（橙）全部落在 2015 年之后，因为它的前提是「多映射读段可以用 EM 分配」这个想法被工程化。

Three histories are visible. The **annotation layer** (blue) runs from 1996 to today, with each bump matching a library or pipeline release. The **structural layer** (green) clusters in 2007–2019, which is exactly the LTRharvest → LTR_retriever → TIR-Learner improvement chain. The **expression layer** (orange) is entirely post-2015, because its precondition — that multi-mapping reads can be allocated by EM — had to be engineered first.

```{r}
#| label: fig-cumulative
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "各子领域的累计工具数：表达层是最后出现的 | cumulative tools per subfield; expression arrives last"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.2
grid <- CJ(year = seq(1996, 2023), category = levels(tl$category))
cnt <- tl[, .N, by = .(year, category)]
grid <- merge(grid, cnt, by = c("year", "category"), all.x = TRUE)
grid[is.na(N), N := 0]
setorder(grid, category, year)
grid[, acc := cumsum(N), by = category]

ggplot(grid, aes(year, acc, colour = category)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = .7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cat_cols, labels = cat_lab, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, 2)) +
  labs(x = "年份 / year", y = "累计工具数 / cumulative tools")
```

## 12. 工具的方法学地图 / A methodological map

把 41 个工具按「方法族 × 子领域」交叉，可以看清哪一格是空的。

Crossing the 41 tools by "method family × subfield" shows which cells are empty.

```{r}
#| label: fig-method
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "方法族 × 子领域：同源比对只服务注释，读段重分配只服务表达 | method family against subfield"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.2
hm <- tl[, .N, by = .(category, family)]
ggplot(hm, aes(category, family, fill = N)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = .9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = N), size = 2.9) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey95", high = blog_pal[["blue"]], guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = cat_lab) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = fam_lab) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 28, hjust = 1))
```

图里最值得注意的空格有两个。第一，**注释类工具里没有一个是纯机器学习的**——分类可以交给 CNN，但「这个东西在哪里、边界在哪」仍然靠比对或结构规则。第二，**表达类工具里没有一个是纯结构的**——它必须先把读段分配掉。这两条不是巧合，而是问题本身决定的：位置问题适合规则，数量问题适合统计。

Two empty cells are worth noting. First, **no annotation tool is purely machine-learned** — classification can go to a CNN, but "where is it and where does it end" still comes from alignment or structural rules. Second, **no expression tool is structural** — reads must be allocated first. Neither is a coincidence: placement suits rules, counting suits statistics.

```{r}
#| label: fig-input
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "每个子领域接受的输入：注释类全部吃组装，表达与插入类全部吃读段 | what each subfield consumes"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.4
ggplot(tl, aes(category, fill = input)) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(assembly = blog_pal[["blue"]],

                               `short reads` = blog_pal[["vermillion"]],
                               `long reads` = blog_pal[["purple"]],
                               `pool seq` = blog_pal[["orange"]],
                               `single cell` = blog_pal[["sky"]]),
                    labels = in_lab, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = cat_lab) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, 2)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "工具数 / tools")
```

## 13. 怎么选 / How to choose

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    Q["我要回答什么？"] --> Q1{"TE 在哪里、属于哪类？"}
    Q["我要回答什么？"] --> Q2{"哪些家族有表达？"}
    Q["我要回答什么？"] --> Q3{"个体间哪些插入不同？"}
    Q1 -->|有参考基因组| A1["RepeatMasker + 物种库<br/>无库先 EDTA / RepeatModeler2"]
    Q1 -->|无参考| A2["RepeatExplorer2<br/>低覆盖读段图聚类"]
    Q2 -->|bulk RNA-seq| B1["TEtranscripts / SQuIRE<br/>家族级 vs 位点级"]
    Q2 -->|单细胞| B2["scTE"]
    Q3 -->|短读段| C1["MELT / RetroSeq / Mobster"]
    Q3 -->|混池| C2["PoPoolationTE2 / TEMP"]
    Q3 -->|长读段| C3["TLDR / 直接比对"]
```

四条经验，都是从上面的结构里推出来的。**第一，库决定上限。** RepeatMasker 再好，也只能找到库里有的东西；没有物种库时，先花时间做 EDTA 或 RepeatModeler2，比调 RepeatMasker 的参数有用得多。**第二，结构工具应当「宽进严出」。** 直接相信 LTRharvest 的默认输出会得到大量假阳性；正确用法是放宽阈值收集候选，再用 LTR_retriever 或人工规则收紧。**第三，表达量只信家族级。** 位点级数字是可辨识性不足时的后验分配，适合看趋势，不适合当定量结果发表。**第四，长读段不是「更准的短读段」，而是换了问题。** 它把推断变成观测，也让组装质量成为唯一的关键变量。

Four lessons follow from the structure above. **First, the library sets the ceiling.** However good RepeatMasker is, it can only find what the library contains; when no species library exists, time spent on EDTA or RepeatModeler2 buys far more than tuning RepeatMasker. **Second, run structural tools loose, then filter hard.** Trusting LTRharvest's raw output yields many false positives; the right use is a permissive threshold followed by LTR_retriever or manual rules. **Third, only trust family-level expression.** Locus-level numbers are posterior allocations under weak identifiability — good for trends, not for publishing as quantities. **Fourth, long reads are not "more accurate short reads", they change the question.** Inference becomes observation, and assembly quality becomes the only critical variable.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pitfalls
#| echo: false
t2 <- data.frame(
  坑 = c("库里混进宿主基因", "共识嵌合或碎片化", "多映射读段被静默丢弃",
        "位点级表达当成观测", "组装缺口让 LTR 断掉", "版本漂移", "依赖考古", "染色体命名不一致"),
  表现 = c("报出根本不是 TE 的家族", "家族数虚高、边界错位", "表达量系统性偏低",
          "结论无法重复", "LAI 低、注释不全", "三年前能跑今天不能", "装不上或跑一半崩", "结果为空但无报错"),
  对策 = c("RepeatClassifier + 人工删", "多工具取交集 + curated 库", "检查 MAPQ 分布与未分配比例",
          "只报告家族级 + 敏感性分析", "先评估 LAI 再解读", "锁定库与工具版本并入库",
          "容器化 / 记录完整环境", "统一 rename 并校验"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
kable(t2, row.names = FALSE, align = "l",
      caption = "八个最常见的坑 | the eight most common traps")
```

## 15. 目录本身作为数据集 / The catalogue as a data set

```{r}
#| label: tbl-genome
#| echo: false
mk <- function(x) {
  data.frame(工具 = x$tool, 年份 = x$year, 语言 = x$lang,
             子领域 = cat_lab[as.character(x$category)],
             分辨率 = ifelse(x$resolution == "family", "家族 / family", "位点 / locus"),
             引用 = x$cite, check.names = FALSE)
}
g1 <- tl[category %in% c("annotation", "discovery", "structure", "classify", "satellite")]
setorder(g1, category, year)
kable(mk(g1), row.names = FALSE, align = "lllll",
      caption = "基因组侧：注释、发现、结构、分类、卫星 | genome side")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-reads
#| echo: false
g2 <- tl[category %in% c("expression", "insertion")]
setorder(g2, category, year)
kable(mk(g2), row.names = FALSE, align = "lllll",
      caption = "读段侧：表达定量与插入检测 | read side")
```

全表 `r n_tool` 个工具：注释 `r n_cat("annotation")`、发现 `r n_cat("discovery")`、结构 `r n_cat("structure")`、分类 `r n_cat("classify")`、表达 `r n_cat("expression")`、插入 `r n_cat("insertion")`、卫星 `r n_cat("satellite")`。语言分布：Python `r n_lang("Python")`、C/C++ `r n_lang("C/C++")`、Perl `r n_lang("Perl")`、Java `r n_lang("Java")`、R `r n_lang("R")`。年份从 `r min(tl$year)` 到 `r max(tl$year)`。

`r n_tool` tools in total: `r n_cat("annotation")` annotation, `r n_cat("discovery")` discovery, `r n_cat("structure")` structure, `r n_cat("classify")` classification, `r n_cat("expression")` expression, `r n_cat("insertion")` insertion, `r n_cat("satellite")` satellite. By language: Python `r n_lang("Python")`, C/C++ `r n_lang("C/C++")`, Perl `r n_lang("Perl")`, Java `r n_lang("Java")`, R `r n_lang("R")`. Years run from `r min(tl$year)` to `r max(tl$year)`.

这个目录当然不完整——每个子领域都还有十来个小工具没进来。它更像是**一张用来定位的地图**：当你拿到一个新的 TE 工具时，先问它落在哪一格（吃什么输入、给什么分辨率、用哪族方法），比读它的摘要快得多。

The catalogue is of course incomplete — every subfield has another dozen smaller tools. It is more like **a map for orientation**: when a new TE tool appears, asking which cell it lands in (what input, what resolution, which method family) is faster than reading the abstract.

## 16. 复现 / Reproducing

所有图都由两个 chunk 生成：`catalog.csv` 是唯一的数据源（`r n_tool` 行，包含工具名、年份、语言、子领域、输入、分辨率、方法、引用），图与表都是它的投影。想加一个工具，只需在 CSV 里加一行，所有计数与图会自动更新。

Every figure comes from two chunks with `catalog.csv` as the only data source (`r n_tool` rows: tool, year, language, subfield, input, resolution, method, citation); figures and tables are projections of it. Adding a tool means adding a row, and every count and plot updates itself.

```bash
powershell -File .trae\skills\rblog-new-post\scripts\render-post.ps1 -Post "posts\2026-11-27 A Field Guide to Transposable Element Tools" -Fresh
```
